_doc: Instruction-parity ledger (T01). One row per baseline instruction that the legacy .claude/ harness enforced or documented. A row records who owns the rule now, where each host reads it, how strongly it is enforced and which test demonstrates it. `status` is honest: `migrated` (one owner, both hosts), `compat-rendered` (owner is the shared rules; a legacy-heading copy is rendered from the same facts for old readers), `legacy-only` (still served only by the project's .claude/ files), `conditional` (applies only when the named precondition holds), `gap` (known loss, not yet fixed — cannot certify the capability), `retired` (dropped on purpose; needs rationale + decision). Validated by scripts/lib/parity.mjs; rendered to docs/harness/instruction-parity.md.
